content.title: Real - Pathways
content.text: Our youth services Real, our provider of youth services, has a range of services to meet the needs of taiohi and their whānau. These services have been developed with and for taiohi, to reflect what matters to them. We’re continuing to expand our services across the motu to meet the ongoing needs of taiohi in our communities. You can find out more, plus where you’ll find us, at Real.org.nz You can also follow Real to see what we get up to and how we support taiohi on Facebook, Instagram and YouTube. I remember the first time I came here. It was fun, all of this was. If I could do this all over again I would and I wouldn’t change a thing. These are some brave youth here. Their future is in their hands..... and I know they will achieve their goals... the best team I have met. Thank you for being positive role models for us. 18 year old, Youth services, Bay of Plenty The pairing system, I feel like my therapist was perfectly suited and matched to me. She was always so understanding and helpful to me. 18 year old, Mobile youth services, Lakes 3,477 supported in last 12 months Real has supported 3,477 taiohi over the last 12 months across our 22 youth services. This has included 101,967 in person or phone contacts with taiohi and their whānau or significant others.
